bio:
Georgia began working with Liza at The Pet Studio as a dog bather at the age of 17. She later trained through the Academy in 2021 and quickly developed a passion for the creative and technical side of professional grooming.

She enjoys the variety that comes from working with different breeds and personalities, from hand stripping spaniels and terriers to creating soft, rounded teddy-bear styles. Georgia brings warmth, enthusiasm and an eye for detail to every groom. Outside work, she enjoys travelling in her converted van with her German Shepherd, Billie.
